name: Front Page Sports: Baseball Pro '98
summary: Front Page Sports: Baseball Pro '98 is a physics-based baseball simulation that offers both arcade and full simulation modes. Players can manage athletes throughout their careers, from rookie season to Hall of Fame induction, using rosters from the 1996 and 1997 MLBPA. The game features realistic physics mechanics rather than probability-based gameplay, and includes internet league play functionality for online competition.
